UNAUTHORIZED: Your session expired or you are not signed in. Please sign in again.
INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: Your platform credit balance is insufficient. Add credits and retry.
PAID_BETA_SOLD_OUT: This private-beta wave is full, so payments are now closed.
PUBLIC_BETA_WAITLIST_INVALID_INPUT: The phone number or reservation consent is invalid. Check it and try again.
PUBLIC_BETA_WAITLIST_NOT_OPEN: Public-beta reservations are not open right now.
RATE_LIMIT: Too many requests. Please retry later
MODEL_NOT_OPEN: Model permission is not activated. Go to https://console.volcengine.com/ark/region:ark+cn-beijing/openManagement?LLM=%7B%7D&advancedActiveKey=model and click "Activate all models" in the top-right of Model Management
MODEL_NOT_REGISTERED: Model is not registered. Add an available model in configuration first
MODEL_NOT_CONFIGURED: No model configured. Please go to Settings and add the required model type before generating.
PROVIDER_AUTH_INVALID: The provider API key is missing, invalid, or lacks permission. Check it in Settings.
PLATFORM_PROVIDER_AUTH_INVALID: The platform model service credentials are temporarily unavailable. The platform operator is handling it; please continue the unfinished work later.
PROVIDER_BILLING_REQUIRED: The provider account balance or spending limit needs attention. Check the provider console.
PLATFORM_PROVIDER_BILLING_REQUIRED: The platform model service has insufficient provider balance. The platform operator is handling it; please continue the unfinished work later.
PLATFORM_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The platform model service is temporarily unavailable. The platform operator is handling it; please continue the unfinished work later.
QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Quota exceeded. Please try again later
GENERATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT: Generation waited in the provider queue for too long. Please submit it again later.
SENSITIVE_CONTENT: The external provider rejected this request under its content policy. Revise the request and try again.
CONTENT_RIGHTS_RESTRICTION: The provider could not complete this generation because the result may involve copyrighted or otherwise protected material. Revise the concept or references, then try again.
MEDIA_INPUT_TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED: The selected model cannot receive this media input in the current deployment.
PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The upload is too large. Choose a smaller file and try again.
UPLOAD_FILE_EMPTY: The selected file is empty. Choose another file.
UPLOAD_MEDIA_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: This media type is not supported. Use PNG, JPEG, WebP, MP3, WAV, or OGG.
PROJECT_ASSISTANT_TEXT_ATTACHMENT_FILE_N: The file needs a valid name.
PROJECT_ASSISTANT_TEXT_ATTACHMENT_UNSUPP: This text file type is not supported. Use TXT, Markdown, or DOCX.
PROJECT_ASSISTANT_TEXT_ATTACHMENT_SIZE_L: The text file is larger than 8 MB. Choose a smaller file.
PROJECT_ASSISTANT_TEXT_ATTACHMENT_CHAR_L: The text file contains too much text. Shorten it and try again.
PROJECT_ASSISTANT_TEXT_ATTACHMENTS_TOO_M: You can attach up to 4 text files to one message.
PROJECT_ASSISTANT_MEDIA_ATTACHMENT_UNSUP: This media type is not supported. Use PNG, JPEG, WebP, MP3, WAV, or OGG.
PROJECT_ASSISTANT_MEDIA_ATTACHMENT_SIZE_: The media file is too large. Images may be up to 25 MB and audio up to 100 MB.
PROJECT_ASSISTANT_MEDIA_ATTACHMENTS_TOO_: You can attach up to 8 images or audio files to one message.
OPERATION_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED: This operation is missing a stable request identity. Start it again.
OPERATION_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID: The request identity is invalid. Start the operation again.
OPERATION_PLAN_REQUEST_REPLAY_DIVERGED: This request was already used for a different generation plan. Start a new operation.
WORKSPACE_RESOURCE_RETRY_TARGET_NOT_FOUN: The failed Resource to retry could not be found.
WORKSPACE_RESOURCE_RETRY_TARGET_DUPLICAT: The same Resource cannot be selected twice.
WORKSPACE_RESOURCE_RETRY_TARGET_INVALID: This Resource is not currently retryable. Refresh and check again.
WORKSPACE_RESOURCE_RETRY_FROZEN_INPUT_MI: The original generation settings are unavailable. Use Edit and regenerate instead.
WORKSPACE_RESOURCE_RETRY_FROZEN_INPUT_AM: The original generation settings cannot be identified uniquely. Use Edit and regenerate instead.
WORKSPACE_RESOURCE_RETRY_FROZEN_INPUT_IN: The original generation settings are no longer valid. Use Edit and regenerate instead.
WORKSPACE_RESOURCE_RETRY_FROZEN_INPUT_MI: The original generation settings no longer match this Resource. Use Edit and regenerate instead.
WORKSPACE_RESOURCE_RETRY_TARGET_CHANGED: The Resource changed before the retry was submitted. Refresh and try again.
VOICE_RESOURCE_ALTERNATIVE_GROUP_MEMBER: This voice belongs to an alternatives group and cannot be physically deleted. Archive it instead.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Server error. Please try again later
NETWORK_ERROR: Network error. Please check your connection
EMPTY_RESPONSE: Model returned an empty response (no meaningful content). Please retry
MODEL_OUTPUT_TRUNCATED: Model output hit its token limit. Reduce the requested output size and retry
CONTEXT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: This task's context is too large to continue. Start a new task or reduce the input
PARSE_ERROR: Model output could not be parsed. Please retry
MODEL_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID: Model output did not match the required schema. Please retry
PLAN_VALIDATION_FAILED: Generated plan did not pass validation. Please revise and retry
PROVIDER_POLL_FAILED: Provider polling failed. Please retry later
PROVIDER_SUBMIT_FAILED: Provider submission failed. Please retry later
PROVIDER_SUBMISSION_REJECTED: The provider could not accept this generation request. Check the input and model settings, revise the request, then try again.
PROVIDER_SUBMISSION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The provider response was lost. Your credits were refunded and this request was not submitted again
EXTERNAL_ERROR: External service temporarily unavailable. Please retry later
OPERATION_PLAN_CHANGED: The task plan or price changed. Generate a new quote before continuing.
VIDEO_API_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED: This video API format is not supported
MUSIC_PROMPT_TOO_LONG: The music prompt exceeds the model's character limit. Shorten it and submit again.
WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT: Task execution timed out and was stopped
WORKER_EXECUTION_ERROR: Task execution failed. Please retry later
AGENT_TEMPORAL_UNAVAILABLE: The assistant execution service is temporarily unavailable. Your command was not silently rerouted; please retry.
AGENT_THREAD_BUSY: The assistant is still processing this conversation. Wait for the current turn to finish, then retry.
AGENT_TURN_COMMAND_REPLAY_DIVERGED: This command identity was already used with different content. Start a new command instead of reusing it.
AGENT_STEER_HANDOFF_UNCERTAIN: The appended message handoff could not be confirmed. To avoid duplicate execution, this message will not be retried automatically; send a new message to continue.
AGENT_START_HANDOFF_UNCERTAIN: The assistant start handoff could not be confirmed. To avoid duplicate execution, this message will not be retried automatically; send a new message to continue.
PROJECT_AGENT_RUNTIME_FAILED: The assistant could not complete this turn. Your committed work and long-running tasks remain preserved.
ASSISTANT_PROVIDER_REQUEST_INVALID: The model provider could not accept this conversation format. Continue the task or switch models and try again.
ASSISTANT_RUNTIME_PROTOCOL_ERROR: The assistant runtime protocol is incompatible with this version. Update the service and try again.
PROJECT_AGENT_ASSISTANT_MODEL_NOT_CONFIG: Configure an assistant model before using the project assistant.
PROJECT_AGENT_ASSISTANT_MODEL_INVALID: The configured assistant model is invalid. Select an available model and retry.
PROJECT_DELETE_ACTIVE_EXECUTION: This project still has active assistant work, pending confirmation, or generation tasks. Finish or cancel them before deleting the project.
PROJECT_AGENT_AI_TURN_PROTOCOL_REQUIRED: The assistant stopped after completing work while another AI-guided step remained available. Send a new instruction to continue; the server will not perform that next action automatically.
networkOffline: You are offline. Check your connection; pending actions have not been submitted.
sseDisconnected: Live updates were interrupted. Reconnecting now; your saved tasks are still safe.
